title: Adventure Backpacks Patched
description: This mod is an updated version of Adventure Backpacks by Darkona. Main change is removing the Sneak-Scroll tool Swapping.
body:
## Description

Adventure Backpack adds 60-something new backpacks with original designs, abilities and they can store fluids!

They will keep their inventory when you die, are impervious to lava and fire, and have some neat abilities:

*   You can craft a Hose that will allow you to suck and spill fluids in the world. Some backpacks have special abilities, and because this is still in development, more will be added over time.  
    
*   They are Crafting Benches too!  
    
*   You can deploy a sleeping bag from your backpack to sleep anywhere!  
    
*   Tools in the special tool slots render on the backpack.  
    
*   Fluids will render inside the tanks. The rendering depends on the quantity.  
    
*   The Hose lets you drink the contents of your backpacks tanks, for various effects.  
    
*   This mod also adds the following:  
    *   To open the backpack inventory while wearing it, press B (configurable)  
        
    *   To switch the tank the hose is bound to, press N while holding it (configurable)  
        
    *   To switch the hose modes, sneak and mousewheel.  
        

## The changes by me(repletsin5)  

Currently I've removed the annoying Sneak-Scroll Tool Swapping, disabled some backs that don't have textures, fixed backpacks applying effects incorrectly.
  
I am willing to patch bugs in the mod. Just go to the [issues page](https://github.com/repletsin5/AdventureBackpack/issues) and make an issue with logs and as much details as possible e.g. what were you doing when the issue occurred.

I am also willing to make QOL changes to the mod. Please do the same thing as above but just about the QOL change that should be implemented and why.

## Note

I will not be updating this mod to newer and older(i might do it for older versions) versions of Minecraft.  
If you want a similar mod for the new Minecraft versions use [Traveller's Backpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/travelers-backpack) for forge, for fabric use [Traveller's Backpack Fabric](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/travelers-backpack-fabric).

The original mod is made by Darkona. [Mod link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/adventure-backpack). It is under the LGPL.
